title: Fill valves.
officialText:
All flush tanks shall be equipped with an antisiphon fill valve conforming to ASSE 1002 or CSA B125. The
fill valve backflow preventer shall be located at least 1 inch (25 mm) above the full opening of the overflow pipe.
